description: ChatGPT is OpenAI’s chat and workspace product for interacting with AI models, documents, tools, and enterprise workflows. It also underpins Codex local tooling and selected partner sign-in flows tied to ChatGPT accounts and workspaces.
summary: chatgpt.com exposes a developer CLI surface (Codex CLI) plus ChatGPT-issued credentials used for ChatGPT/Codex sign-in and Sign in with ChatGPT OAuth, but its documented HTTP API surfaces for model inference live on other OpenAI domains rather than chatgpt.com.
